title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Smartsheet
providers.scope_notes: API tokens need Business/Enterprise/AWM; SAML, token expiration and Directory Integration are Enterprise; Event Reporting is an Enterprise/AWM add-on; Gov and Regions use separate tokens.

controls.name: API Access Token expiration period
controls.what: Sets one expiration for all existing and future user and OAuth tokens in the plan; expired tokens are revoked.
controls.setting: Admin Center > Security & Control > API Access Token tile > Expiration period
controls.quote: Once a System Admin sets expiration times, all existing and future tokens within the plan adhere to this duration and are automatically revoked upon expiration.

controls.name: Revoke (delete) API access token
controls.what: User deletes their own token in the UI.
controls.setting: Account > Personal Settings > API Access > Manage API Access Tokens
controls.quote: You can also revoke (delete) API access tokens in the  API Access  >  Manage API Access Tokens  page.

controls.name: Revoke access token (DELETE /token)
controls.what: Revokes the token used to make the call; later calls with it fail.
controls.quote: Revokes the access token used to make this request. The access token is no longer valid, and subsequent API calls made using the token fail.

controls.name: Deactivate user
controls.what: Blocks the user and immediately revokes all API access tokens they generated.
controls.setting: Admin Center > Users and Groups > Seat Types and True-up > Deactivate; or POST /users/{userId}/deactivate
controls.quote: Deactivating a user immediately revokes all API access tokens they've generated. The deactivated user can no longer use them.

controls.name: Directory Integration (Okta / Entra ID SCIM)
controls.what: Removing or unassigning the user in the IdP deactivates them on next sync, which revokes their tokens.
controls.setting: Admin Center > Security & Controls > Directory Integration
controls.quote: When a user is removed from Okta or unassigned from the Smartsheet app, they're automatically deactivated in Smartsheet on the next sync.

controls.name: Admin Center API page
controls.what: Shows users with active tokens used in last 30 days and endpoint call counts; view-only.
controls.setting: Admin Center > API (Endpoints, API users tabs)
controls.quote: The API page in Admin Center gives System Admins a clear picture of API activity across their organization, such as who holds API tokens, what endpoints they're calling, and how often.

no_control.quote: You can’t assign individualized or role-based expiration dates, as this is a general setting for all tokens under the specified plan.

no_control.what: Revoking tokens from the Admin Center API page
no_control.quote: System Admins can review API data, but can't revoke tokens or manage API access directly through this interface.

authentication.summary: User generates a raw token in Personal Settings > API Access; it is sent as an Authorization: Bearer header and acts with the user's full access. Shown once. Tokens are per environment (commercial, Regions, Gov).

federation.details: API calls need only the bearer token. SAML, domain-level SAML and domain strict docs describe sign-in methods and sessions only and say nothing about existing or new API tokens. No doc states tokens are blocked or re-checked under SAML-only sign-in. IdP deprovisioning via Directory Integration deactivates the user, and deactivation revokes the user's tokens.

ip_restriction.boundary: No Smartsheet doc found describing IP allowlisting for API tokens. Event Reporting records source IP only for WEB_APP events.

lifetime.summary: No expiry by default; Enterprise admins can set one plan-wide expiration

renewal.expiry_basis: plan-wide expiration set by System Admin, counted from token creation
renewal.summary: Personal tokens cannot be refreshed or extended; user generates a new one.

administration.summary: Users create and delete their own tokens. Admins can set plan-wide expiry (Enterprise), see token holders and endpoint call counts on the Admin Center API page (view-only), and kill all of a user's tokens by deactivating the user. A System Admin's token can call the API as any plan user via the Assume-User header. SCIM provisioning (Okta/Entra) is configured with a System Admin's personal token, not a separate credential.
administration.conditions: Token creation requires Business, Enterprise or AWM. No documented setting to block users from creating tokens or for an admin to revoke one specific token of another user.

sso.details: Only documented case: API calls by external collaborators to items protected by 'Require work accounts with SSO' fail unless exempt; docs are silent on SSO for internal users' tokens.

offboard.details: Deactivating a user (manually or via SCIM directory sync) immediately revokes the user's API access tokens.

inventory.details: No admin token list found; Event Reporting ACCESS_TOKEN - AUTHORIZE events (Enterprise/AWM add-on) show tokens being created.

offboard.ui: Admin Center > Users and Groups > Seat Types and True-up > user row ⋮ > Deactivate

token_format.notes: No documented prefix. Docs example bearer value is 38 alphanumeric characters. Value shown once at creation.

log_sources.name: Event Reporting (GET /events, List filtered events, SIEM)
log_sources.notes: Premium add-on for Enterprise/AWM; System Admin; six months from enablement. Built-in SIEM streaming needs Safeguard or Advance Platinum.

log_sources.name: Admin Center API page
log_sources.notes: Business/Enterprise; last 30 days, refreshed daily; user-generated tokens only; call counts per endpoint and user; CSV export; excludes deactivated/removed users.

credential_id_fields.notes: Present on API calls when the token was named at creation.
Mnemonic shown in UI; not unique.
User whose data the token can access (token owner).

lifecycle_events.notes: Deactivation revokes all the user's tokens; no per-token event documented for this.

anomaly_cues: ACCESS_TOKEN - AUTHORIZE for users who don't normally use the API, especially System Admins (Assume-User).
Bursts of SHEET - LOAD / ATTACHMENT - LOAD with an API_* source.
No source IP on API events; pivot on accessTokenName and requestUserId instead.
New user appearing on the Admin Center API users tab.

containment.steps: Owner deletes the token under Personal Settings > API Access, or call DELETE /token with it. Admin: deactivate the user (revokes all their tokens), then reissue as needed.
containment.notes: Revoked token fails on later calls. Admin revocation of a single token of another user is not documented.

unknown: Whether list/search calls (GET /sheets, GET /search, GET /users) produce events.

calls.reveals: Org user list; admin attributes for System Admins
